The provided logs appear to be from a DNS server (dnsmasq) and an audit log from a Linux system (videoserver). The dnsmasq logs show DNS queries to faaacebook.com, which is a suspicious activity as it is not a typical DNS query. The audit logs show the zmcontroller process making DNS queries and attempting to connect to faaacebook.com on port 443, which suggests a potential attack. The use of alternate credentials (root) and the fact that the process is making multiple attempts to connect to the same host further support this conclusion.
